image_query: Adam's Bridge Ram Setu NASA satellite photo Rameswaram Sri Lanka
tweets: Ram Setu — Adam's Bridge — a 48-km chain of limestone shoals joining Rameswaram to Mannar Island, Sri Lanka. The Rāmāyaṇa's Yuddha Kāṇḍa calls it Setubandhanam: raised in five days by Rama's vānara army under Nala, son of Viśvakarmā, its stones said to float upon the sea.
